description: This file implements a security skill scanner for code files, including rules for detecting dangerous patterns, managing cache, and scanning directories and files for security issues.

methods.name: isScannable
methods.description: Checks if a file extension is among the supported scannable extensions.

methods.name: clearSkillScanCacheForTest
methods.description: Clears the internal cache used for scanning.

methods.name: scanSource
methods.description: Scans a source code string for security-related findings based on predefined rules.

methods.name: scanDirectory
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory for files and returns all security findings.

methods.name: scanDirectoryWithSummary
methods.description: Scans a directory and provides a summary including counts of critical, warning, and info findings.
